desc: Start profiling until you exit this command yourself or when duration is done. Default is CPU profiling with a 30s timeout.
u: zsysctl-service-trace - Start profiling until you exit this command yourself or when duration is done. Default is CPU profiling with a 30s timeout.
Start profiling until you exit this command yourself or when duration is done. Default is CPU profiling with a 30s timeout.

--duration=30
Duration of the capture. Default is 30 seconds.
-h, --help[=false]
help for trace
-o, --output=""
Dump the trace to a file. Default is ./zsys.<trace-type>.pprof
-t, --type="cpu"
Type of profiling cpu or mem. Default is cpu.
